package.name: csa_bridge_msgs
package.description: Message definitions for csa_bridge: CompressedPoseBatch, a batch of 6-DOF poses compressed with CSA (github.com/<owner>/collapsible-scissored-surfaces-algorithm-) for the specific bandwidth-constrained link a real ROS2 PoseStamped + MCAP/zstd pipeline measurably loses on. Split into its own package because rosidl message generation needs ament_cmake, while csa_bridge itself is a plain ament_python package.
